 The giallorossi squad for Udinese v Roma
 October 30, 2026 
 Copy 
 Gian Piero Gasperini has issued the list of players called up for Udinese v Roma, day number 10 of Serie A. 
 Here are the players available to the coach.
 Goalkeepers:  Vasquez, De Marzi, Gollini
 Defenders:  Rensch, Koulierakis, Ndicka, Molina, Hermoso, Mancini, Balerdi, Wesley, Lulli, Ghilardi
 Midfielders:  Cristante, De Roon, Pisilli, Di Nunzio, Mora
 Forwards:  Castro, Malen, Soulé, Camara
